4. (Currently Amended) A method of impeding Leishmania transmission comprising administering to a human subject a composition comprising fractions or sub-fractions of Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes called fucose mannose ligand (FML) derived from __Leishmania chagasi or Leishmania infantum__ and saponin, wherein said composition is formulated as a blocking vaccine __with a dosage and administration schedule specifically optimized for human immunization to elicit blocking antibodies in humans that prevent transmission of Leishmania by sandfly vectors__.

5. (Currently Amended) Use of the composition of claim 4 for preparation of a blocking vaccine __in humans__ to impede Leishmania transmission.

6. (Currently Amended) Use of the composition of claim 4 for preparation of a reagent comprising said composition further comprising suitable pharmacological vehicles, for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission __specifically in humans__.

7. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 4, wherein the Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) __derived from Leishmania chagasi or Leishmania infantum__ comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexoamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates: 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of mannose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, aminoacids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine.
